audiences.name: Researchers and analysts
audiences.detail: You already frame good questions and read data. We turn that into requirements work.

audiences.name: Banking and finance staff
audiences.detail: You know the processes analysts get hired to fix. Learn to document and improve them.

audiences.name: Operations and support
audiences.detail: You see where systems break every day. That is the raw material of good requirements.

audiences.name: Graduates and early career
audiences.detail: Start with a clear path and a portfolio, instead of guessing what employers want.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.detail: The IT analyst role, the software delivery lifecycle, Agile and Scrum against Waterfall, and how analysts work with project managers and product owners.

phases.name: Stakeholders and elicitation
phases.detail: Interviews and workshops, stakeholder mapping, prioritisation, and the 4C Framework: Clarity, Conflict, Consensus, Commitment.
phases.tools: MoSCoW, RICE, 5 Whys, fishbone, story mapping

phases.name: Requirements and modelling
phases.detail: Business and functional requirements documents, user stories and acceptance criteria, process and data modelling, and reading an API the way an analyst does.
phases.tools: BPMN 2.0, UML, ERDs, SQL joins, REST and JSON in Postman, Figma wireframes
phases.deliverable: Requirements document, process maps and backlog

phases.name: Delivery
phases.detail: Traceability, user acceptance testing, change management, and working in regulated settings such as fintech and telecoms.
phases.tools: Test case design, defect triage, traceability matrix, integrations and webhooks, RPA basics

phases.name: Career launch
phases.detail: The board presentation, a CV and LinkedIn rewrite, mock interviews, and your ECBA roadmap.
phases.tools: Portfolio review, STAR interview practice, BABOK mapping

includes: Two live sessions a week for 12 weeks
A capstone project and a peer review pod
Template pack: requirements document, user stories, UAT plan, traceability matrix
An interview question bank, email templates and mock interviews with feedback
